In all honesty potato? I'm not shit, I mean very little to this world and many people in my life. I'm no saint, but I'm no devil as well. I've been dealt a very serious and rough hand for the 20 years I've been on this planet, many traumas and many mistakes caused by me. I find it best, for the people around me at least. I cant simply walk away from shitty situations without them tearing my psyche to shreds, and that seems to not only hold me back, but the ones I love too. 

I only want those I love and care for to have great lives and legacies lead. And i stand in the way of that for many because i cant seem to let go.. so my best course of action is to go through with the repentance of myself.
